info.description: REST API for the EventHub platform
info.title: EventHub API

get.description: Returns a database page of shared users ordered by userId ascending, with their current global roles. Only users on this page are looked up in Keycloak, with at most four concurrent lookups and a 15-second total role-lookup timeout. Available only to global admins. total counts all database users; concurrent user creation or deletion can cause count/page differences.
Returns the effective global roles for a user. Available only to global admins.

put.description: Replaces the user's global roles with the submitted set. Only global admins may perform this change; the change is applied in Keycloak and takes effect after a fresh token or login.

post.description: Reserviert Tickets für ein veröffentlichtes Event. Die Reservierung verfällt nach Ablauf von expiresAt, solange sie nicht bestätigt wurde. Bestätigt wird sie über den Zahlungsvorgang (POST /bookings/{bookingId}/payment).

409.description: Event nicht veröffentlicht oder Kapazität überschritten

get.description: Liefert den gespeicherten Zahlungsvorgang einer Buchung des Aufrufers: Betrag, Zahlungsstatus, Buchungsstatus und eine verständliche Meldung. ticketsValid ist nur bei bezahlter und bestätigter Buchung true, deren Event stattfindet oder stattgefunden hat. Buchung, Zahlung, Event-Status und Datenbankuhr stammen aus einer Abfrage. Offene Zahlungen abgelaufener Reservierungen schließt ein Hintergrundjob jede Minute als fehlgeschlagen ab.

404.description: Buchung nicht gefunden oder kein Zahlungsvorgang gestartet

post.description: Überführt eine Reservierung des Aufrufers in einen Zahlungsvorgang. Der Betrag ergibt sich aus Ticketanzahl mal Veranstaltungspreis, wird gespeichert und vor Abschluss angezeigt; Beträge vom Client werden ignoriert. Ein erneuter Aufruf liefert den offenen Zahlungsvorgang unverändert zurück (200). Die Zahlung muss vor expiresAt abgeschlossen werden. Ist die Reservierung abgelaufen oder das Event zurückgezogen, wird eine offene Zahlung dabei als fehlgeschlagen gespeichert und 409 geliefert. Buchungen anderer Nutzer liefern 404.

409.description: Buchung nicht reserviert, Reservierung abgelaufen, Event nicht mehr verfügbar oder Zahlung bereits abgeschlossen

post.description: Schließt den offenen Zahlungsvorgang mit einem simulierten Ergebnis ab; es ist kein echter Zahlungsdienstleister angebunden. amount muss dem gespeicherten Betrag entsprechen, sonst wird nichts geändert (422). Bei success wird die Buchung verbindlich bestätigt (bookingStatus confirmed, ticketsValid true). Bei failure, abgelaufener Reservierung oder zurückgezogenem Event schlägt die Zahlung fehl (status failed, failureReason, message), die Buchung erhält keinen Ticketanspruch und die Tickets werden freigegeben. Das Ergebnis wird innerhalb der Transaktion aus dem gespeicherten Zahlungsstatus gelesen. Der Body darf höchstens 4 KiB groß sein (413).

200.description: Ergebnis des Zahlungsvorgangs, erfolgreich oder fehlgeschlagen

404.description: Buchung nicht gefunden oder kein Zahlungsvorgang gestartet

409.description: Zahlung bereits abgeschlossen oder Buchung nicht reserviert

422.description: Betrag weicht vom gespeicherten Betrag ab

post.description: Creates an in-app reminder for an own confirmed booking of an upcoming published event. scheduledAt is 24 hours before the event or now for short-notice bookings. Simulation displays it immediately. Repeated calls refresh the existing reminder from current event data. Changed reminders become unread. No email or external delivery service is used. Foreign bookings return 404.
TEST ONLY — accepts username/password and returns a Keycloak access token. Disabled in production (requires DEBUG_ENABLED=true).

get.description: Public list of published events with their category and location. Optional location searches city or venue name; categoryId selects an exact category. date selects the start calendar day in Europe/Berlin (YYYY-MM-DD). All filters are combined using AND. Omit a filter or pass an empty value to reset it. Unknown categories and searches without matches return 200 with []. Invalid dates, invalid category UUIDs or location values exceeding 200 characters after trimming return 400. Events missing a category or location are omitted. Sorted by start time and event ID.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of city or venue name; trimmed, empty means no filter, maximum 200 characters. Wildcards are treated literally.
parameters.name: location

parameters.description: Exact category UUID; trimmed, empty means no category filter. Combined with location using AND.
parameters.name: categoryId

parameters.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in Europe/Berlin. Empty means no date filter.
parameters.name: date

post.description: Creates an event in status draft. Drafts are only visible to the organization that owns them and can be edited (PUT /events/{id}) and published (POST /events/{id}/publish) later. Requires the event_manager role in the owning organization. organizationId is the Keycloak organization ID or alias as returned by GET /users/me; it may be omitted when the caller manages events in exactly one organization.

get.description: Returns all events of the organization, in every status including drafts. The organization is addressed by its database UUID or by its alias, which is what tokens carry. Requires membership in the organization, regardless of role. Organizations the caller is not a member of return 404, like unknown ones.

200.description: Events of the organization; an empty array if there are none

get.description: Returns the events of all organizations in which the caller holds the event_manager role, ordered by start time. Use status=draft to list the own drafts. Drafts are never visible to other organizations or visitors.

parameters.description: Only return events in this status
parameters.name: status

200.description: Own events; an empty array if there are none

get.description: Public event details with description, category, location, price, capacity, availableSeats and bookable. Available seats account for confirmed tickets and unexpired reservations. soldTickets counts confirmed tickets; occupancyPercent is their share of capacity, rounded to two decimals and capped at 100. availability is available, almost_sold_out (at least 90% confirmed and still bookable), sold_out (confirmed tickets exhaust capacity), or temporarily_unavailable (live reservations block booking). Sold-out published events remain visible with bookable=false. Booking via POST /bookings requires authentication and checks availability again. Unpublished events and events missing category or location return 404.
Returns the remaining available seats for an event. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event or the global admin role.

Public average score and review count. Only visible ratings with scores 1–5 linked to confirmed bookings of this event count; ticket quantities do not weight reviews. No valid ratings returns averageRating=null and ratingCount=0. Published events and ended completed events expose summaries; drafts and cancelled events return 404. Averages are not rounded.
Returns the number of confirmed tickets sold for an event. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event or the global admin role.

Returns the share of the capacity taken by confirmed bookings, in percent with two decimals and capped at 100; 0 if the capacity is 0. Reserved and cancelled bookings are not counted. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event or the global admin role.

put.description: Updates title, description, time span, location, category, price and capacity of an event. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event. Only events in status draft or published can be edited. The capacity cannot be lowered below the tickets already sold or reserved (409).

409.description: Capacity below the tickets already sold or reserved

delete.description: Irrevocably deletes a draft event. Requires the event_manager or org_admin role in the organization that owns the event. Only events in status draft can be deleted; published, cancelled and completed events return 400. Events with bookings in any status are never deleted and return 409, because the bookings belong to the booking history of the visitors. The audit log entries of the event are kept.

post.description: Publishes a draft event so that visitors can find and book it. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event. Only sufficiently complete events in status draft can be published. If the event is already published, returns 400 with detail "this event is already published".

Creates one rating per authenticated visitor and event. The visitor must have a confirmed booking for this event, and the event must have ended without being cancelled. Text is optional (at most 2000 characters); score must be between 1 and 5. Ratings are visible immediately.

Withdraws a published event so that it is no longer bookable. Requires the event_manager role in the organization that owns the event. Only events in status published can be withdrawn; the event status becomes cancelled.

put.description: Hides (hidden=true) or shows again (hidden=false) a rating. Requires the global role admin or moderator. Hidden ratings no longer count towards rating summaries and recommendations. The reason (1-1000 characters after trimming) is required and is stored with the acting user in the audit log of the organization that owns the rated event (organization_id "platform" if the rating no longer belongs to an organization). Requesting the current visibility returns changed=false and records nothing.

get.description: Returns only the authenticated user's notifications, newest first. The response contains items, page, limit and total; empty pages return items: []. readAt is null for unread notifications. Simulated reminder content and scheduledAt are refreshed from current event and location data before display; changed reminders become unread. Simulation is immediately visible, even before scheduledAt; no email is sent.

patch.description: Idempotently sets readAt. Foreign and unknown notifications return 404. Changed simulated reminders become unread again on their next refresh.

post.description: Creates a new organization in Keycloak and the API database. Requires the admin role on the backend client.

get.description: Returns the audit log of an organization, newest entries first: who (personal account) changed what and when. Covers event changes (including price changes, publishing and cancellation) and changes of member roles. Requires the org_admin role in the given organization (global admins bypass this check). organizationID is the Keycloak organization ID or alias. Entries of operations in Keycloak consist of a "started" entry and a "succeeded" or "incomplete" entry with the same operationId; a "started" entry without a result means the outcome is unconfirmed. Entries are deleted ten years after they were recorded. Use nextCursor from the response as cursor to get the next page.

put.description: Replaces the complete role set of an organization member. Requires the org_admin role in the given organization (global admins bypass this check); it is checked against the token and again against Keycloak, so a demoted admin cannot act on an old token. organizationID is the Keycloak organization ID or alias as returned by POST /organizations and GET /users/me. roles is required; an empty array removes all roles. Roles: org_admin (manage members), event_manager (manage events), finance_viewer (view sales and billing). Removing the last org_admin is rejected. The affected user must refresh their token before the new roles take effect.

parameters.description: Complete role set for the member (empty array = no roles)
parameters.name: request

get.description: Public average of unrounded event averages, with equal weight per rated event. Includes only this organization's published or completed events with endTime <= database time. Uses the same visible, score 1–5, confirmed-booking ratings as event summaries. Unrated events do not contribute. No rated events returns averageRating=null and ratedEventCount=0. Recommendations retain their existing calculation.

parameters.description: Organization database UUID (not Keycloak ID or alias)
parameters.name: organizationID

get.description: Returns future published events with free capacity, excluding the user's confirmed bookings. Active reservations count toward capacity. Ranking weights category affinity (50%), confirmed ticket popularity (40%), and organizer ratings (10%).

parameters.description: Maximum number of recommendations after ranking; omitted returns all recommendations
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile, global roles, active organization, and organization memberships

amount.description:
Amount shown to the user before completing the payment, as JSON number or string; it must
equal the stored amount.

outcome.description: Outcome the simulated payment provider reports; no real payment provider is connected.

organizationId.description:
Keycloak ID or alias of the organization that owns the draft, as returned by GET /users/me.
May be omitted when the caller manages events in exactly one organization.

amount.description: Number of tickets times the event price when the payment process was started.

expiresAt.description: Deadline for completing a pending payment; omitted once the payment is completed.

message.description: Human readable result of the payment process.
message.example: Payment successful. Your booking is confirmed.

ticketsValid.description: True only when the payment is paid and the booking is confirmed.

BearerAuth.description: Enter "Bearer {token}" where {token} is a Keycloak access token
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
